newsitem.title: USA: Gensia gets FDA ok for drug substance.
newsitem.headline: Gensia gets FDA ok for drug substance.

text.p: Gensia Sicor Inc and SangStat Medical Corp said Monday the U.S. Food and Drug Administration had approved a Gensia unit's application to make the drug substance bulk cyclosporine.
SICOR spa is a unit of Gensia Sicor.
SangStat's Abbreviated Antibiotic Drug Application for U.S. marketing clearance of a cyclosporine drug product based on the drug substance is still under FDA review.
Cyclosporine is an immunosuppressive drug used in transplantation to prevent graft rejection.
